_comment: Deliberate, reviewed divergences from the reference smali. Each entry must name the class, the method, and why the change is intended. The oracle reports anything not listed here as UNEXPLAINED - so this file is the record of every behavioural decision taken since the reconstruction reached equivalence.

deviations.reason: Version string bumped v3.10 -> v3.11 to match the APK's versionName. Upstream did this at build time with a sed over the smali (see reference/build.sh); here it lives in the source. Keeping the two in sync by hand is a known wart - see docs/recommendations.md for the BuildConfig fix that would remove it.
